name: Hunter
source:
A cheerful young farmer who was born and raised in the valley. He lives and works on one of the biggest farms in the area alongside his family. No matter what, he's always eager to help someone in need! 

Fun fact: He's best friends with Jude.

[From [url=https://www.gretuskigames.com/peachleaf-valley/]official website[/url]]
